title: Sentences on Wisdom and Conduct
english: That one, for whom time overflows.
Do not accept the outward appearance of a Christian man, but rather the mindset of his soul. To grasp the ungraspable God is sin. The danger of the mouth and tongue is great.

It is absurd for one who pursues honors to flee from the labors through which honors are gained. If you wish to know God, first having known yourself. A true friend is one who shares circumstances. It is terrible to think greatly while performing small deeds. In everything, the desire to know hinders the actual knowing. A demon of irrational life is a leader. The nobility of the soul shines forth from its strength. That God-fearing man is he who does not speak of himself. A holy man of God is ungraspable. A life of unproven character is the worst of possessions. Speak what is necessary and when it is necessary, and you will not hear what is not necessary. An unshakeable friend is the greatest of possessions. A glory-loving opinion is a sickness of the soul. A stranger and a poor man is the beloved of God. He who receives him will quickly rise up. On the one hand, to do good to all.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Sententiae on Virtue and the Soul
english: [It is] beautiful, but rather [it is for] those not able to be repaid. A rhetorician in justice is a cup of cold water. Sobriety and meekness are the Cherubim of the soul. To be greedy in old age is a proof that one has become greedy before old age; to be diligent in youth is a pledge of being greedy in old age. True contemplation is the upper room of the soul. Loving what is not necessary, you will not love what is necessary. A counterfeit gold is better than having acquired a friend. A pure soul is god with God. Oh, from the self-love that hates all things.

Other sayings: The beginning of love is the assumption of glory. It is beautiful to be rich in meekness and love. The lightning-strike of virtue is a proud calculation. A smooth path is made by almsgiving. An unjust judge is a stained conscience. It is terrible to be a slave to the passions of the flesh. If you wish to be without sorrow, strive to please God. He who takes good care of himself is cared for by God. A sober heart is a harbor of contemplations. When...
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Knowing oneself and the path to Christ
english: If you wish to know who you are, do not compare who you were, but what you have become from the beginning. A glory-seeking soul is a dry pit. A proud soul is a receptacle for robbers, and it hates the sound of knowledge.

For a true man, not knowing the Scriptures is a bad wandering. If you fear God, know him through tears. The humility of the soul is an unutterable weapon. A lover of virtue is a tree of paradise. Jesus Christ is the wood of life; use it as is necessary and you shall by no means die for eternity.

Do good to the truly poor and you will eat Christ. To eat the body of Christ is true strength. If you love Christ, you will not neglect to keep his commandments; for from there one shines as a benefactor with God. He who is a friend according to God flows with milk and honey in true words, but a restless soul will not have such a friend.
A glory-seeking thought is a shouting master. To bury the truth is to silence gold. He who fears God does all things according to God.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
